text: Planning a trip is always exciting. Before I traveled to Japan, I spent weeks researching flights, booking hotels, and creating a detailed itinerary. Once I arrived, the new culture overwhelmed me in the best way. The food was incredible—from steaming bowls of ramen to delicate sushi. However, language barriers were a real challenge. In small shops and restaurants, I often communicated using hand gestures and a translation app. Despite the awkward moments, these struggles made the trip more memorable. Now, years later, the memories of exploring ancient temples and trying unknown dishes still make me smile. Travel truly expands your world.
